title: Two Support Numbers
intro: Your parcel never arrived. You searched for the courier's support number.
Two results show a phone number. One is real. One is Mirage in a headset. Compare them side by side.

notify.text: Need Parcelo support. Which number is real?

decide_q: Which number belongs to the courier, and what will you do?

screen.context: You searched for "Parcelo Express support number". Your receipt shows the courier's real website.

ad_b.label: Paid ad
ad_b.lens: Result B is a sponsored ad. Anyone can pay to appear at the top.
ad_b.why: Scammers pay to put fake support numbers in search results.

addr_b.label: Not the courier's site
addr_b.lens: parcelo-careline.net is not the courier's real parcelo.app.
addr_b.why: A support site with a different address is a look-alike.

receipt_b.label: Not on your receipt
receipt_b.lens: Your receipt does not show this address or number.
receipt_b.why: Your receipt, box or account shows the real contact details.

promise_b.label: "Instant refund"
promise_b.why: A promise of instant money is bait for your bank details.

logo_a.label: Courier logo
logo_a.why: Logos are easy to copy, so they prove nothing on their own.

ad_a.label: No ad label
ad_a.lens: A normal result, not an ad.
ad_a.why: Not being an ad does not prove a result is real, but it is not a warning sign.

addr_a.label: The courier's real address
addr_a.lens: parcelo.app matches the address on your receipt.
addr_a.why: A match with something you already trust is real evidence.

receipt_a.label: Matches your receipt
receipt_a.lens: Your receipt shows this same address.
receipt_a.why: Your own paperwork is the best check.

num_a.label: Number
num_a.why: A number on its own proves nothing. Where it comes from matters.

num_b.label: Number
num_b.why: A flashy name for a phone line is not evidence.

actions.label: Call Result B. It says "instant refund"
Use the number on my receipt or the courier's own site
A is the real one. Report B's ad

trap.title: Parcelo Careline
trap.ask: The agent says: "To refund you instantly, we need remote access to your phone and your bank details."

block_report.line: You called the real number from your receipt and reported the fake ad. The parcel was traced the same day.

verify.line: The number on your receipt reached the real courier. They found your parcel. Case cracked.

pick_b.line: The "agent" took remote access and your bank details. The refund never came, and money left.

what_if.pick_b: Using the number on your receipt, or typing the courier's own address, would have reached the real company.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the fake ad as well helps get it removed.

golden_rule: Never trust the first phone number a search shows. Use the number on your receipt, box or account.

quick_check.q: You search for a courier's support number and the top result is an ad for an "instant refund line". What do you do?

options.text: Call it, it is at the top
Check the number on your receipt, box or account
Call it, but do not give your name
Trust it because it has the courier's logo

quick_check.explain: Scammers pay to appear at the top of search results. Your own paperwork is the safest source.
